notes.title: Release Date + Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Knight of the Lions now has a release date: November 27, 2025! Hopefully, it stays this way.

The demo has also been updated. It now features voice acting instead of just text, and your progress will carry over into the full version.

Thank you so much for your patience and support!

notes.title: Knight of the Lions Release Date is Delayed
notes.notes:
The game will be postponed due to continuing war in Ukraine. Recent missile strikes resulted in power outages throughout the country. Sometimes the electricity supply is on only for a few hours per day. It is really hard to work under these circumstances.

The game is now planned to be released in the second quarter of 2023. Thank you for your understanding. If you wish to support the development of Knight of the Lions, you can do it on this Patreon page. All backers will get a digital copy of the game as soon as it is released.
